brief: Holds a blocking TCP listener that accepts clients one at a time and hands each back as a connected stzTcpClient.
detail: Listen starts the listener and returns at once; the application then calls AcceptOne, or AcceptOneWithin to give up after a time, in its own loop. There is no event loop: the Disconnect and Message callbacks are stored and never called. Pass 127.0.0.1 as the host for a local test, because an empty host listens on every interface. The documentation was run only against a client in the same process on the loopback address, stopped afterwards.
